# HirePulse SEO Keyword & Domain Intent Matrix

> Interactive browser matrix and pricing calculator showcasing `hirepulse/keyword-search-volume` and `hirepulse/domain-seo-overview` with verified test-run datasets (`keyword-volume.json` and `domain-seo.json` for `stripe.com`).

## Connect an AI Agent via MCP

- **Keyword Search Volume (`hirepulse/keyword-search-volume`):**
  - Remote MCP Server: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/keyword-search-volume`
  - Local stdio (Claude Desktop / Cursor): `npx -y @apify/actors-mcp-server --tools hirepulse/keyword-search-volume` (with `APIFY_TOKEN` in `env`)
  - REST API: `POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/hirepulse~keyword-search-volume/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=<APIFY_TOKEN>`

- **Domain SEO Overview (`hirepulse/domain-seo-overview`):**
  - Remote MCP Server: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/domain-seo-overview`
  - Local stdio (Claude Desktop / Cursor): `npx -y @apify/actors-mcp-server --tools hirepulse/domain-seo-overview` (with `APIFY_TOKEN` in `env`)
  - REST API: `POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/hirepulse~domain-seo-overview/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=<APIFY_TOKEN>`

- **Both SEO Tools Together:**
  - `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/keyword-search-volume,hirepulse/domain-seo-overview`

## WebMCP Browser Tools Exposed on This Page

Browser agents supporting WebMCP (`navigator.modelContext` / `document.modelContext`) can invoke:
1. `calculate_keyword_search_volume_cost`: Computes exact pay-per-use cost for `N` keywords across `L` lookups (`$0.03 * L + $0.005 * N`).
2. `query_verified_seo_samples`: Filters and returns the verified `keyword-volume.json` and `domain-seo.json` (`stripe.com`) records.

## Verified Facts & Pricing

- **`hirepulse/keyword-search-volume` (`https://apify.com/hirepulse`):**
  - Google monthly search volume, CPC, competition and keyword ideas.
  - Output fields include `keyword`, `search_volume`, `cpc_usd`, `competition`, `competition_level`, `keyword_difficulty`, `search_intent`, `low_top_of_page_bid_usd`, `high_top_of_page_bid_usd`, `trend_monthly_pct`, `trend_quarterly_pct`, `trend_yearly_pct`, `ai_search_volume`, `country`, `language`, `source`, `seed_keyword`, `metrics_available`, `data_updated_at`.
  - **Price:** `$0.03` per lookup + `$0.005` per keyword result.
  - **Free Plan:** Real volume, CPC and difficulty for the first 3 keywords of each run (the free preview depends on availability and can be paused).
- **`hirepulse/domain-seo-overview` (`https://apify.com/hirepulse`):**
  - Estimated organic traffic, ranking keywords, traffic value and competitor domains for any domain.
  - Overview fields include `organic_traffic_estimate`, `organic_keywords`, `organic_traffic_value_usd`, `keywords_top_3`, `keywords_top_10`, `keywords_top_20`, `keywords_new`, `keywords_up`, `keywords_down`, `keywords_lost`, `paid_keywords`, `paid_traffic_estimate`.
  - Ranked-keyword rows (`record_type: "ranked_keyword"`): `keyword`, `position`, `url`, `search_volume`, `cpc_usd`, `keyword_difficulty`, `search_intent`, `traffic_estimate`.
  - **Price:** Pay per result on the Apify Store (see the tool page for current prices).
- **Apify Free Plan (`https://apify.com/pricing`, checked 2026-10-16):** $0, with $5 per month to spend in Apify Store or on your own Actors ("No credit card required").

- `"ai agents"`: `search_volume: 49500`, `cpc_usd: 20.9`, `competition: 0.46` (`MEDIUM`), `keyword_difficulty: 67`, `search_intent: "commercial"`, trends `0% / 0% / 0%`.
- `"web scraping api"`: `search_volume: 1900`, `cpc_usd: 13.05`, `competition: 0.28` (`LOW`), `keyword_difficulty: 59`, `search_intent: "informational"`, trends `-33% / -33% / -33%`.
